acceptance_predicates.description: Valid historical evidence-ledger rows remain accepted and projected without false digest rejection.
The reviewed handoffctl implementation remains at or below 200000 bytes and rejects oversize state.
A bound envelope resolves declared product test paths within its explicit scope without broadening isolation.
Malformed digests, oversize state, and out-of-scope product paths fail closed.

definition_of_done: Bind immutable spec, envelope, and isolated worktree.
Repair historical ledger validation/projection, the size guard, and bounded product test-path resolution.
Pass focused positive and hostile tests plus the configured non-formal quality gates.

inputs.description: Authoritative ASB state projection and evidence-ledger validation.
Reviewed handoffctl implementation and state-size guard.
Bound execution envelope and product test-path scope.

outputs.description: Bounded projection, size, and product-path scope repair.
Focused positive and hostile test evidence.

gates.description: Focused projection, size, and product-path tests pass.
Configured non-formal state/product quality gates pass.
AR-1948 and all prior task histories remain unchanged.
